selfMaintenanceTrayPlugins.name: self maintenance tray plugins
selfMaintenanceTrayPlugins.description: Tray plugins maintained by their own lifecycle and not restarted on crash. Loaded together in one process group.
selfMaintenanceTrayPlugins.description[zh_CN]: 由自身维护生命周期、崩溃后不自动重启的托盘插件，集中在一个进程组中加载。

subprojectTrayPlugins.name: subproject tray plugins
subprojectTrayPlugins.description: Tray plugins maintained by sibling subprojects, isolated in their own process group.
subprojectTrayPlugins.description[zh_CN]: 由同级子项目维护的托盘插件，独立成组加载以便隔离。

crashProneTrayPlugins.name: crash-prone tray plugins
crashProneTrayPlugins.description: Tray plugins known to be unstable, isolated in their own process group so a crash does not affect other plugins.
crashProneTrayPlugins.description[zh_CN]: 已知不稳定的托盘插件，独立成组加载，崩溃时不影响其他插件。
